figure.line: She took out four twenties 'cause she liked round figures
stanza: Waltzing Matilda whipped out her wallet
She took out four twenties 'cause she liked round figures

figure.songTitle: We the People Who Are Darker Than Blue
figure.line: We're just good for nothing, they all figure
stanza: We people who are darker than blue
Are we gonna stand around this town
And let what others say come true?
We're just good for nothing, they all figure
Now we can't hardly stand for that
Or is that really where it's at?
